main_text.p: materiam accommodam, tanquam contra institutum Christi introductam ad consecrandum. Pontificius licet praetendat, nec praeter rem, Christum in Azymo confecisse, moderatiorem se gerit, & pronunciat, cum utrumque panis Enzymus & Azymus panis sit, utrumque, sive acceptum a Christo, sive non acceptum æquebene consecrandum venire. Expunxi, signauiq; errorem recentis Schismatici Xanthopuli, qui Synaxaria illa concinnauit, & insperfis erroribus, & hæresibus proprijs commaculauit. Illa Synaxaria, cum laterent in tenebris, tandem his postremis temporibus e latebris eruta, nebulone quopiam, sive Xanthopulus ita, ut sunt, ea composuerit, sive ab hoc impostore erroribus illis conspurcata, procurante, in lucem prodierunt, in usum Græcæ Ecclesiæ. Quod probaui firmiter, eo potissimum, quod in Synaxario post diem Pentecostes sermonem habens de Spiritu sancto dicit, illum procedere ex Patre solo; in alia postmodum eiusdem Synaxarij editione omissa est vocula, solo. Quæ hæc infantia est, si erat in Archetypo, quare in una editione omissum est, si non erat, quare additum? Hinc arguebam, Synaxarijs illis ita peruersis nullam fidem habendam esse. notauique errores in illis contentos. Sic eleuauit auctor[?]-rita-
main_text.notes: Printed line-end hyphens at the bottom ("auctor-", "rita-") are transcribed as printed; the word split there is doubtful and marked [?]. "infperfis" is read as "insperfis" (long s printed as f-like form); the reading is probable but not certain. Scan-edge marks on the left and right are not printed text and are left out. The last line continues onto the next page.
